description: Main entry point for a Flutter-based attendance system app. Defines App initialization, root widget setup with provider for app state management, theming, routing, splash screen, home shell with bottom navigation, and drawer with logout functionality.

classes.name: AttendanceApp
classes.description: Root widget that initializes Provider, theme, and application routes, setting up the main structure of the app.

classes.name: _SplashScreen
classes.description: Displays a loading indicator while the app initializes.

classes.name: _HomeShell
classes.description: Manages bottom navigation for Attendance and Reports screens, along with a drawer that includes user info and logout functionality.

classes.name: _HomeShellState
classes.description: State class for _HomeShell, managing selected navigation index and UI behavior.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Dart entry point, initializes Flutter binding and environment variables, then runs the app.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the root widget (AttendanceApp) and child widgets based on app state.
